execution_scope: Full approved Phase 5 spec: public-good Worker API, 5-item notice UI, homepage/admin Animal Island visual pass, attribution, validation, and review.

claims.promise: Public-good rendering uses a custom project UI rather than the third-party iframe/widget/JS embed as the default implementation.
Homepage adds the public-good notice after the first viewport and before the portfolio list.
Public-good data is integrated through a Worker proxy instead of direct browser dependence on third-party CORS/stability.
Each cache cycle displays a group of 5 public-good records rather than a single record.
The public-good module uses five avatars plus one detail notice-board interaction.
Homepage and admin receive page-level Animal Island visual strengthening, not only local component imports.
Cloudflare Pages static export, Worker API, D1 model, live iframe display, and UptimeFlare status merge remain preserved.
Phase 5 does not add public-good CMS configuration, exposure stats, third-party widget defaulting, auth/CRUD/model rewrites, iframe removal, monitoring-first UI, or multi-user admin.
Execution scope includes public-good module, homepage visual strengthening, and admin visual strengthening together.
Visual language presents homepage as a portfolio island, public good as a public notice board, and admin as an island office while keeping project-owned layout and logic.
Worker returns a stable PublicGoodBatch DTO with the documented person, contacts, source, cache, fallback, and message fields.
Worker filters fields, validates structure and URLs, clips text, handles fallback, and frontend consumes only the project DTO.
Frontend requests a public read-only Worker endpoint such as `/public-good`, and Worker requests `https://api.isoyu.com/gy/api.php`.
Public-good data rotates by cache cycle, defaults to 6 hours, remains stable within the cycle, and avoids forced third-party calls on every refresh.
Cache refresh requests the third-party API at most 8 times, dedupes by id, stops at 5 valid items, and fills shortages from previous cache or fallback.
Worker accepts only https childPic/detailUrl values, trims and clips text fields, does not pass raw third-party JSON, exposes no secrets, and follows existing CORS policy.
Frontend displays local fallback public-good notice when the Worker request fails.
Public-good module title uses 公益公告 or equivalent Chinese and keeps copy to source explanation and detail entry without extra slogan.
Desktop public-good UI shows 5 circular avatar entries, selected Animal Island styling, selected detail board, photo, and animal-island-ui or same-style detail button.
Mobile public-good UI uses horizontal scroll or wrapping avatars, shows detail below avatars, does not rely on hover, and prevents text/photo/button overlap.

Homepage information architecture keeps brand first, public-good notice after hero, portfolio list after public-good notice, and status summary as lightweight island information rather than dashboard metrics.
Public-good notice is visible, does not steal the hero, and is not mixed into the portfolio grid where it would resemble an ad card.
Project cards remain live iframe-centered while shifting visually away from monitoring windows; iframe lazy loading, interaction switch, offline/unknown fallback, and visit entry remain.
Admin remains single-admin, unauthenticated password-only, authenticated site list/editor/open/delete/save/error workflow, and existing Worker CRUD.
Admin is visually strengthened as an island office using animal-island-ui or same-style Card/Input/Button/Select/Switch/Tag/Modal/Table equivalents and Chinese form errors.
Admin visual strengthening does not hide critical fields or reduce edit/save/cancel/delete reachability, and mobile admin has no compressed buttons, text overflow, or form overlap.
Root `animal-island-ui/style` import remains and README or page footer keeps suitable attribution and non-commercial/CC-BY-NC-4.0 note.
Public-good errors handle third-party failure, invalid structure, image load failure, invalid detail link, fewer than 5 records, and frontend Worker failure without blanking the UI.
Site-list failure does not block public-good fallback; public-good failure does not block portfolio list; Animal Island components do not break iframe/status/Worker/D1 paths.
Verification runs npm run test:admin, npm run lint, npm run build, and Worker related typecheck or tests according to change scope.

Browser validation checks desktop and mobile homepage/admin/public-good visual behavior, placement, 5 avatars, detail switching, readability, no overflow, no overlap, readable buttons, and no new console errors.

Users can perceive Animal Island in the overall UI without reading source, public-good is natural public notice, real API uses 5-item batch, API/image/link failures do not break homepage, and core portfolio/admin capabilities do not regress.
Public-good module is not presented as an ad slot and naturally integrates as a public notice.
Public-good module uses the 姬长信 API公益中国 endpoint as the real source for 宝贝回家/公益寻亲 information.
